signatures.description: Implement a shaping pipeline equivalent to HarfBuzz for Arabic and Devanagari: derive joining forms (R/D/C/L with ZWJ, ZWNJ and tatweel rules), run GSUB lookup types 1-4 in lookup-index order honoring lookup flags (IgnoreMarks, IgnoreBaseGlyphs, MarkAttachmentType) so glyph skipping is correct, then apply GPOS mark-to-base attachment offsets. Cluster values must remain monotonic across ligature substitution and mark reordering, and a naive left-to-right substitution must visibly fail on the 3000-string corpus of Arabic-indic numerals, ZWJ forms and Devanagari conjuncts. Deliverable: shape.mjs reading cases.jsonl and writing out.jsonl with glyph ids, clusters and advances, judged against reference runs.
